2608.27358.title: RCMN: Understanding Misleadingness in Influential Public Discourse
2608.27358.paper_summary: Influential public discourse shapes public beliefs and can also mislead, not only through what is stated, but also through how information is framed, omitted, contextualised, and communicated. Yet less research has focused on how such misleadingness arises and shapes the interpretations formed by readers. To address this gap, we introduce Reader-Centric Misleadingness Understanding (RCMN), a framework that operationalises misleadingness through five dimensions: misleading mechanism, likely reader interpretation, evidence-warranted interpretation, emotional arousal, and communicative intent. Based on this framework, we construct an evidence-grounded dataset of influential public discourse. Empirical findings show that misleadingness is diverse and extends well beyond fabrication, with unsupported inference, exaggeration, and omission among the prevalent mechanisms, and is frequently associated with heightened emotional arousal and distortive communicative intent. Moreover, we investigate whether lightweight claim-and-context representations retain sufficient cues for understanding reader-centric misleadingness without access to richer contextual, evidential, and multimodal information. Evaluation across five recent generative foundation models shows that reader-level interpretations can often be recovered from such limited representations, whereas identifying how misleadingness is produced remains considerably more challenging. These findings highlight the potential of lightweight representations for scalable misleadingness analysis, while reliable understanding of misleading mechanisms continues to require richer contextual and evidential grounding.
2608.27358.paper_summary_zh: 有影響力的公共話語塑造了公共信念，也可能會誤導，不僅通過所陳述的內容，還通過信息的框架、遺漏、上下文和傳達方式。然而，對於這種誤導性如何產生以及如何影響讀者形成的解釋，研究相對較少。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了以讀者為中心的誤導性理解（RCMN），這是一個通過五個維度來操作化誤導性的框架：誤導機制、可能的讀者解釋、證據支持的解釋、情感喚起和傳達意圖。基於這一框架，我們構建了一個以證據為基礎的有影響力公共話語數據集。實證研究結果顯示，誤導性是多樣的，遠不止於虛構，無支持推斷、誇大和遺漏是常見的機制，並且通常與情感喚起的增加和扭曲的傳達意圖相關。此外，我們還調查了輕量級的主張和上下文表達是否保留了足夠的線索，以理解以讀者為中心的誤導性，而不需要訪問更豐富的上下文、證據和多模態信息。在五個最近的生成基礎模型中的評估顯示，讀者層級的解釋通常可以從這些有限的表達中恢復，而識別誤導性是如何產生的仍然相當具有挑戰性。這些發現突顯了輕量級表達在可擴展的誤導性分析中的潛力，而對誤導機制的可靠理解仍需更豐富的上下文和證據基礎。
